text: Never have I ever written a love letter or romantic message
Never have I ever had a crush on someone for more than a year without saying anything
Never have I ever slow danced in an unexpected place
Never have I ever stayed up all night talking to someone I had feelings for
Never have I ever planned a surprise date or romantic gesture
Never have I ever watched a sunrise or sunset with someone I had feelings for
Never have I ever been on a first date that felt like a movie scene
Never have I ever received flowers from someone
Never have I ever held hands with someone and not wanted to let go
Never have I ever had a song that felt like it was written for a relationship I was in
Never have I ever kissed someone in the rain
Never have I ever been given a nickname by someone I had feelings for
Never have I ever made a playlist for someone special
Never have I ever shared an umbrella on a rainy day
Never have I ever written someone's name in the sand or snow
Never have I ever been on a picnic date
Never have I ever had a secret crush on a friend
Never have I ever flirted without realizing it until later
Never have I ever stayed in a relationship longer than I should have
Never have I ever fallen asleep talking to someone I liked
Never have I ever sent a 'thinking of you' message first
Never have I ever had butterflies the moment someone walked in the room
Never have I ever cooked a meal specifically to impress someone
Never have I ever kept a photo of someone in my phone longer than the relationship lasted
Never have I ever imagined our wedding before we were even officially together
